response.sql:
WITH signal_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    COUNT(*) as signal_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) as fraction
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
tenthlargest AS (
  SELECT MIN(fraction) as min_frac
  FROM (
    SELECT fraction
    FROM signal_counts
    ORDER BY fraction DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) AS top_10
)
SELECT 
  telescref,
  signal_count,
  fraction
FROM signal_counts
WHERE fraction >= (SELECT min_frac FROM tenth_largest)
ORDER BY fraction DESC;

assumptions.assumption: All signals in the signals table are included in the count, with no filtering by signal type, status, or other attributes.
